description.value:
A layer of flat quills seated under the skin that stand up on impact. Resistance 2 to piercing and slashing. A creature that hits you with an unarmed Strike or a natural weapon, or that grabs you, takes 1d6 piercing.

Rider: They rise when you are afraid, visibly and audibly. You take a –2 penalty to Deception checks to feign calm, and you can't conceal that you're rattled.

cinderfall.incomplete: The reactive 1d6 piercing damage to whoever hits or grabs you with an unarmed/natural attack targets another creature's HP from a self-held item -- same architecture gap as Grave-Quiet/Root-of-the-First-Fire (mutations pass). The narrow -2 penalty to Deception checks specifically to feign calm also has no clean predicate: Deception has no 'feign calm' sub-action slug (unlike Impersonate or Feint), so scoping it correctly isn't possible without over-applying it to all Deception.
